title: Vectura AI Markers
description: Unified marker definitions for AR alignment. Supports entrance (session init) and checkpoint (mid-route correction) roles.

entranceMarkers.description: At least one entrance marker is required for session initialization.

checkpointMarkers.description: Optional checkpoint markers for mid-route alignment correction.

id.description: Unique marker identifier (must be unique across all markers)

role.description: Marker role. Entrance markers initialize the AR session; checkpoint markers apply mid-route corrections.

qrPayload.description: QR code content (JSON or URI with building/marker IDs)

positionX.description: Marker X position in building-local coords (meters)

positionY.description: Marker Y position in building-local coords (meters)

rotationYDegrees.description: Marker rotation around Y-axis in degrees

nearestNodeId.description: Closest nav-graph node to this marker

physicalWidthMeters.description: Physical width of the printed marker for AR scale

physicalHeightMeters.description: Physical height of the printed marker

referenceImageName.description: Name of the AR reference image asset
